result.topic_en: This page continues the table of primes of the form 4n+1 between 1697 and 1997. Each prime is written as a sum of two squares, with the residue a for which a^2+1 is divisible by that prime.

items.quote:
Tabula ergo haec in ſe complectitur omnes numeros
primos formae $4n+1$ infra 2000 exiſtentes, eiusque
ergo ope omnes numeri inueniri poſſunt, quorum qua-
drata vnitate aucta per vllum horum numerorum pri-
morum ſint diuiſibilia.
items.english: This table therefore contains all prime numbers of the form 4n+1 below 2000. By its help, therefore, all numbers can be found whose squares, increased by one, are divisible by any of these prime numbers.

items.quote:
